pre_research.what_is_this: Scaled Chinese express network: self-operated hubs/linehaul plus franchised endpoints.
pre_research.economic_direction: express unit economics, franchise health, owner cash conversion
pre_research.why_surfaced_now: H1 profit inflected after years when cost gains were partly competed away.
pre_research.current_expression_or_leadership: 600233 A-share; Research can freeze before Odds.
pre_research.basic_business_role: Coordinate high parcel density through hubs, linehaul and franchised last mile.
pre_research.potential_fundamental_driver: Durable price discipline plus structural cost reduction and lower reinvestment.
pre_research.current_market_expectation_hypothesis: Fresh 2027 street center is about CNY7.27bn.

material_claims.statement: 2026H1 volume was 16.278bn parcels; parent NP ~CNY3.175bn and express parent NP ~CNY3.361bn.
Ten fresh post-H1 forecasts put 2027 parent NP at CNY7.01-7.542bn; median ~CNY7.301bn and mean ~CNY7.267bn.

pre_research.obvious_contradiction: H1 improvement combined real cost gains with easier industry competition.
pre_research.largest_unknown: How much H1 per-parcel profit survives normalized competition without hurting franchise economics?
pre_research.next_discriminating_search: Test unit economics, network health, capex and low-return adjacent businesses.

quick_research.business_model: Hub/linehaul network plus franchised pickup/delivery; economics depend on density, price and network health.
quick_research.segment_mix: Domestic express is core; aviation/international are smaller and currently lower-return.
quick_research.economic_role: Network coordinator measured by per-parcel economics and owner cash returns.
quick_research.value_chain_position: Central network/brand between shippers and franchised endpoints.
quick_research.current_industry_state: Price competition is being disciplined; cost efficiency still differentiates.
quick_research.market_expectation_hypothesis: Fresh 2027 consensus needs much of H1 unit profit to persist.

supporting_claims.statement: 2026H1 unit revenue/cost/gross profit were CNY2.17/1.90/0.27; transport/center costs CNY0.36/0.26.
H1 OCF/cash capex were ~CNY3.959bn/3.482bn; 2025 OCF/cash capex ~CNY7.850bn/8.607bn.
H1 aviation gross margin was ~-47.86% and international express/parcel gross margin ~1.70%.
Company says franchise delivery-fee expectations/levels are basically stable; pickup/delivery cost also reflects mix and settlement rules.

contradictory_claims.statement: Regulators found some brands' franchise delivery fees below minimum delivery cost; this is industry context, not YTO-specific.

quick_research.evidence_authority_assessment: Filings own facts; company Q&A is policy, not realized franchise returns; regulator is industry context; sell-side defines expectations only.
quick_research.variant_perception: The issue is not parcel growth; it is whether current unit profit is durable owner earnings after franchise and capex needs.
quick_research.route_reason: Probability needs a causal owner-earnings bridge.

material_claims.statement: H1 filing attributes unit-margin improvement to both lower unit costs and easier competition; cash conversion also improved.
Do not capitalize H1 unit profit as permanent unless price discipline, franchise health and lower reinvestment persist together.
Five 2027 worlds use probabilities 15/25/35/20/5 from price-war relapse to network compounder.

explicit_falsifiers: Express unit profit stays materially below CNY0.18 for two quarters without a structural cost reset.
YTO-specific evidence shows material franchise or network deterioration despite HQ margin gains.
Rolling cash capex stays at/above OCF while unit economics and utilization fail to improve.
2027 company earnings evidence moves materially below CNY6.0bn on weaker core economics.
Aviation/international keep absorbing material capital without credible positive incremental returns.

adversarial_findings.finding: No; filing also cites easier competition.

adversarial_findings.question: HQ cost down equals moat?
adversarial_findings.finding: No; realized franchise returns remain undisclosed.

research_snapshot.core_thesis: Scaled network compounder candidate, but current profit is partly price-discipline sensitive. Durable owner earnings require volume, price, structural cost gains, healthy franchise economics and lower reinvestment together.
research_snapshot.market_expectations_narrative: Fresh post-H1 2027 forecasts center near CNY7.27bn. This is MARKET_CONTEXT, not truth; our weighted earnings are lower because H1 durability is unproven.
research_snapshot.model_risk_notes: Franchise returns are undisclosed; one H1 cannot prove a permanent price regime; maintenance capex and adjacent ROIC are unresolved; PE/share-count are explicit assumptions.
thesis_invalidation: Express unit profit stays materially below CNY0.18 for two quarters without a structural cost reset.
YTO-specific evidence shows material franchise or network deterioration despite HQ margin gains.
Rolling cash capex stays at/above OCF while unit economics and utilization fail to improve.
2027 company earnings evidence moves materially below CNY6.0bn on weaker core economics.
Aviation/international keep absorbing material capital without credible positive incremental returns.
